    'Merchant_Rating',
    'Fraud_Flag',
    'Is_International'
]
corr = final_merge[num_cols].corr()
plt.figure(figsize=(8,6))
sns.heatmap(corr, annot=True, fmt = '.2f', cmap='coolwarm')
plt.title("Correlation Heatmap")
plt.show()
